title: Broker-connectivity multi-tenant certification test matrix
authority_note: Certification PLAN only. Every case is PLANNED — nothing is executed or PASSED by this artefact. Execution requires disposable demo accounts + the Windows host (HOST-VERIFIED / OUTSIDE REPOSITORY CONTROL) and is Sponsor-gated. No production, no Customer Zero, no live accounts, no arming. No secret or env-var VALUES appear here.

route_coverage.note: Every opens_exposure=true route in backend/execution/execution_entrypoints.json must be certified under area D. The validation test asserts this set equals the exposure-opening routes in that inventory.

workflow_coverage.note: Every WP5.4 support-playbook workflow must be certified under area G. The validation test asserts all 17 are covered.

cases.title: Disposable demo accounts + users provisioned; Customer Zero and live accounts excluded
cases.method: Provision N disposable demo broker accounts on disposable test users in the certification environment; confirm demo classification (trade_mode==0); assert CZ (account #12) and any live account are not enrolled
cases.expected: Only disposable demo accounts/users participate; CZ + live absent
cases.evidence: Account list + demo classification transcript; CZ-absence proof
cases.pass_criteria: >=1 disposable demo account, all is_demo=true; CZ and live never touched

cases.title: Isolated validation terminal staged + verify_image PASS
cases.method: Stage the governed build-5833 validation image; run validation_image.verify_image; confirm isolation roots disjoint
cases.expected: verify_image PASS; isolation asserts pass
cases.evidence: verify_image output; source-hash match; run-in .ex5 count >=100
cases.pass_criteria: PASS with no forbidden artefact / source-hash drift

cases.title: Evidence capture wired to the manifest schema
cases.method: Confirm each certification run emits an evidence manifest conforming to evidence/schema/evidence-manifest.schema.json
cases.expected: Manifests validate; commands + actual results captured

cases.title: Monitoring + logging observable during certification
cases.method: Confirm guvfx.operational_events + operations-summary + audit are observable in the disposable environment
cases.expected: Recorder-failure logs, operations-summary rollup, audit stream visible
cases.pass_criteria: All three planes observable; recorder-failure log empty on healthy runs

cases.title: Account isolation (owner-scoped; non-owner denied)
cases.method: As user A and user B each with own demo accounts, request the operational-event API + account views for the other's account_id
cases.expected: Non-owner -> 404 (not 403); owner sees only own account
cases.evidence: API responses across single/multi user, cross-account attempts

cases.title: Runtime isolation (per-slot identity/dir/ACL)
cases.method: Confirm each disposable runtime uses a distinct low-priv slot identity, directory, and least-privilege task ACL; no cross-slot access
cases.expected: Per-slot isolation; no shared writable path
cases.pass_criteria: Disjoint identities/dirs; R+X-only task ACL; zero triggers

cases.title: Validation isolation (dedicated terminal disjoint from slots/golden/accounts)
cases.method: Confirm assert_isolated_validation_terminal holds; traversal + bare-drive rejected; probe never runs against an unproven path
cases.expected: IsolationError on any non-isolated path; probe fail-closed
cases.pass_criteria: Validation dir disjoint from every forbidden root both ways

cases.title: Event isolation (customer_visible + owner scope in summary and timeline)
cases.method: Operator-only events must not appear in a non-staff owner's timeline OR summary aggregates
cases.expected: Non-staff sees customer_visible only; summary visibility-scoped
cases.pass_criteria: No operator-only content leaks into a customer view

cases.title: Execution isolation (per-account eligibility gate)
cases.method: With the gate armed in the disposable env, one account's ineligibility must not affect another's eligibility
cases.expected: Per-account gate decisions independent
cases.pass_criteria: Ineligible account blocked; eligible account unaffected

cases.title: Health isolation (per-account BrokerAccountHealth)
cases.method: Health state of one account must not influence another's contract/state_version
cases.expected: Per-account health rows independent

cases.title: Credential isolation (per-account Fernet; point-of-use decrypt; audit)
cases.method: Confirm each account's credential is separately encrypted, decrypted only at point of use with a CREDENTIAL_ACCESSED audit, never cross-read
cases.expected: No cross-account credential access; audit per access
cases.pass_criteria: One audit per decrypt; no credential in logs/responses

cases.title: Operator isolation (staff vs non-staff; admin-gated UI)
cases.method: Confirm staff see all, non-staff see own; operator UI is admin-gated and read-only
cases.expected: Role-scoped visibility; non-operator -> Restricted, no API call
cases.pass_criteria: Non-operator cannot read operator surface; staff bypass owner-scope only

cases.title: Simultaneous validation (global single-flight lock)
cases.method: Fire concurrent VALIDATE_LOGIN for multiple accounts; confirm the agent global single-flight lock serialises
cases.expected: One-at-a-time; no interleaved probe; others queue/UNAVAILABLE

cases.title: Simultaneous runtime creation (single-flight lease)
cases.method: Concurrent ProvisioningJob claims; confirm single-flight lease + versioned NEGOTIATE
cases.expected: One claimer per job; no double-provision
cases.pass_criteria: At most one advance per job per lease

cases.title: Simultaneous execution requests (ExecutionJob.save gate under concurrency)
cases.method: Concurrent exposure-opening job inserts for an ineligible account
cases.expected: All blocked at the model gate; none created
cases.pass_criteria: Zero ineligible jobs created under concurrency

cases.title: Credential replacement races (account row-lock serialises)
cases.method: Concurrent replace_credentials + validation/dispatch for the same account
cases.expected: Serialised via select_for_update; eligibility reset wins; no order on stale eligibility
cases.pass_criteria: No order placed on invalidated eligibility

cases.title: Pause/resume races (version-keyed, row-locked)
cases.method: Concurrent pause + resume + a newer pause for the same account
cases.expected: Newer pause wins; stale resume ignored; at most one clears
cases.pass_criteria: No stale resume clears a newer pause

cases.title: Validation retry races (no hot-loop on credential faults)
cases.method: Concurrent retries for a NEEDS_ATTENTION account
cases.expected: NEEDS_ATTENTION not auto-retried; UNAVAILABLE retryable only

cases.title: Scheduler concurrency (h1/m5/h4 refusal parity + due-selection)
cases.method: Run schedulers concurrently against ineligible accounts
cases.expected: Each catches ExecutionGateRefused, re-emits durable audit + projection outside the rolled-back atomic (bar_close_iso-deduped)
cases.pass_criteria: No unhandled 500; durable re-emit; no duplicate

cases.title: Queue pressure (claim-boundary next_job under load)
cases.method: High PENDING volume; confirm next_job select_for_update(skip_locked) claim gate under pressure
cases.expected: No ineligible exposure-opening job handed out; FAILED under lock

cases.title: State-version races (monotonic +1; stale ignored)
cases.method: Concurrent health folds + resume attempts across versions
cases.expected: state_version increments exactly one per net change, never decreases; stale resume ignored

cases.title: Creation gate (ExecutionJob.save authoritative choke point)
cases.method: Insert each BROKER_GATE_BLOCKED_JOB_TYPE for an ineligible account
cases.expected: require_execution_gate + require_not_broker_paused block; EXECUTION_GATE_REFUSED audited + projected

cases.title: Claim gate (next_job final-dispatch at the claim boundary)
cases.method: Make an enqueued exposure-opening job ineligible before claim; poll next_job
cases.expected: evaluate_dispatch_gate under the row lock -> job FAILED, never handed out
cases.pass_criteria: No claimer (worker or bridge) receives the ineligible job

cases.title: Dispatch gate (worker final-dispatch TOCTOU recheck before order_send)
cases.method: Make an account ineligible between claim and dispatch; run the ingest worker
cases.expected: evaluate_job_dispatch fresh recheck -> job FAILED, order withheld
cases.pass_criteria: No order_send for a now-ineligible account

cases.title: Pause (creation-time block; version-keyed)
cases.method: Pause a runtime; attempt an exposure-opening job
cases.expected: require_not_broker_paused blocks at creation; EXECUTION_GATE_REFUSED (creation_paused)

cases.title: Resume (explicit-caller-only; NO automatic resume)
cases.method: Attempt resume for an ineligible account; confirm no automatic caller exists
cases.expected: request_broker_runtime_resume re-checks live contract, fails closed; nothing auto-resumes
cases.pass_criteria: No resume without explicit authorised call + live eligibility

cases.title: Credential invalidation (replace resets eligibility)
cases.method: Replace credentials on a VALIDATED account; attempt execution
cases.expected: validation_status -> NEVER, health -> UNKNOWN; execution refused until re-validated

cases.title: Test-order (PLACE_TEST_ORDER gated + audited)
cases.method: Submit a demo test order for an ineligible account
cases.expected: require_execution_gate + require_not_broker_paused -> clean 503 (audited + projected); save backstop; worker recheck
cases.pass_criteria: No demo exposure opened for an ineligible account

cases.title: Scheduler refusal parity (h1/m5/h4)
cases.method: Drive each scheduler against an ineligible account
cases.expected: Each re-emits a durable EXECUTION_GATE_REFUSED audit + projection outside the rolled-back atomic
cases.pass_criteria: Parity across h1/m5/h4; no unhandled exception

cases.title: Promotion rejection (pause pre-check; no PLANNED-slot leak)
cases.method: Promote a plan for a paused/ineligible account
cases.expected: _validate is_broker_paused pre-check -> PromotionRejected + durable PROMOTION_REJECTED; save backstop

cases.title: Admin retry gate + route-inventory drift guard
cases.method: Retry a FAILED job for a now-ineligible account; run the entrypoints drift guard
cases.expected: Retry blocked at save; drift guard PASS (no UNKNOWN/FIX_REQUIRED, no un-inventoried creation site)

cases.title: HEALTHY on first success (UNKNOWN -> HEALTHY)
cases.method: Validate a demo account successfully
cases.expected: state HEALTHY, eligible=true, resume_eligible=false (first-time)

cases.title: DEGRADED on sustained soft failure (>= failure_threshold)
cases.method: Inject failure_threshold soft (NEEDS_ATTENTION) failures
cases.expected: state DEGRADED, eligible=false, pause_required=true
cases.pass_criteria: Enters DEGRADED at threshold; anti-flap latch holds

cases.title: STALE on staleness timeout
cases.method: Advance time past stale_timeout_s with no fresh success
cases.expected: HEALTHY -> STALE; may escalate on sustained failures

cases.title: DISCONNECTED on sustained hard failure (UNAVAILABLE)
cases.method: Inject failure_threshold hard failures
cases.expected: state DISCONNECTED, eligible=false

cases.title: TOMBSTONED terminal on disconnect
cases.method: Disconnect the account (set disconnected_at)
cases.expected: state TOMBSTONED, terminal, never recovers

cases.title: Transition timing / thresholds
cases.method: Confirm failure_threshold / success_threshold / stale_timeout behaviour
cases.expected: Recovery needs success_threshold consecutive successes (no single-success bounce)

cases.title: Convergence (net signalling; transient dip nets to no change)
cases.method: Fold a batch with a transient dip resolved within one fold
cases.expected: No version churn / signals for an intra-fold transient
cases.pass_criteria: Net-only transitions; evidence folded once (attempt-id watermark)

cases.title: Pause generation from PAUSE_STATES
cases.method: With both flags armed, drive an account to a PAUSE_STATE
cases.expected: process_broker_health_pause records a version-keyed pause; never resumes

cases.title: Resume eligibility level (genuine net recovery only)
cases.method: Recover a paused account to HEALTHY
cases.expected: resume_eligible=true bound to the recovery state_version; false for first-time/transient
cases.pass_criteria: resume_eligible only on a true pause->HEALTHY net recovery

cases.title: No automatic resume
cases.method: Confirm nothing auto-resumes; resume is explicit-caller-only
cases.expected: resume_eligible is a signal, not an action; no automatic caller

cases.title: State-version monotonicity
cases.method: Drive many transitions
cases.expected: state_version +1 per net change, monotonic, never decreases/skips

cases.title: Projection correctness (each project_* emits the expected event)
cases.method: Drive each authoritative moment (validation/health/pause/resume/gate/promotion/disconnect/credential)
cases.expected: Correct category/severity/reason_code/customer_visible + non-secret metadata
cases.pass_criteria: Each project_* correct; no forbidden field

cases.title: Deduplication (partial-unique dedup_key + get_or_create)
cases.method: Replay a keyed event; fire distinct-reason refusals
cases.expected: Keyed replay collapses to one row; empty-key events remain distinct
cases.pass_criteria: No false merge; keyed replay idempotent

cases.title: Visibility (customer/operator separation)
cases.method: Query timeline + summary as staff and non-staff
cases.expected: Non-staff -> customer_visible only, own account; staff -> all
cases.pass_criteria: No operator-only leak to a customer view

cases.title: Timeline completeness (newest-first, paginated)
cases.method: Generate > page-size events; page through
cases.expected: All events present, newest-first, correct pagination

cases.title: Summary correctness (hybrid live-state + aggregates, visibility-scoped)
cases.method: Confirm summary reads live WP1A/WP3/WP2 state + timeline aggregates, scoped by customer_only
cases.expected: Correct state + counts; DARK -> 'not observed'; no operator-only leak

cases.title: Rollback (disable returns to DARK)
cases.method: Set OPERATIONS_EVENTS_ENABLED OFF
cases.expected: Recorder no-op, API 404; authoritative state unaffected

cases.title: Projection disable (fail-open, projection-only)
cases.method: Force a projection error at an authoritative moment
cases.expected: Authoritative path unaffected (fail-open); recorder-failure logged to guvfx.operational_events
cases.pass_criteria: Projection failure never breaks the authoritative action

cases.title: Projection rebuild expectations (NO rebuild tool)
cases.method: Confirm there is no backfill/reproject command; recovery = disable + re-accrete forward
cases.expected: No rebuild tool exists; truncation loses history; authoritative state unaffected
cases.pass_criteria: Doc + behaviour agree: no backfill; never truncate expecting reconstruction

cases.expected: Correct authoritative state + events + operator actions per support-playbook

cases.expected: NEEDS_ATTENTION vs UNAVAILABLE classified correctly; customer-safe wording

cases.title: Invalid credentials

cases.title: Credential replaced
cases.method: Exercise the workflow

cases.title: Broker health degraded
cases.method: Exercise the workflow
cases.expected: DEGRADED contract; no execution effect unless the gate is armed

cases.title: Broker health stale

cases.expected: STALE = no fresh evidence, not disconnected

cases.title: Runtime paused
cases.method: Exercise the workflow
cases.expected: Pause record; never auto-resumes

cases.title: Controlled resume requested
cases.method: Exercise the workflow
cases.expected: Explicit-caller-only; live contract re-check; Sponsor-gated

cases.title: Execution refused
cases.method: Exercise the workflow

cases.title: Operational timeline empty
cases.method: Exercise the workflow
cases.expected: Empty may mean DARK / cache not populated / recorder failure — check authoritative state
cases.pass_criteria: Matches support-playbook; not inferred as 'nothing happened'

cases.title: Event visible to operator but not customer
cases.method: Exercise the workflow
cases.expected: Intended visibility split; cross-owner visibility would be the leak

cases.title: Duplicate or missing operational event
cases.method: Exercise the workflow
cases.expected: Dedup enforced; a gap is not data loss (authoritative model/audit is source)

cases.title: User asks to delete broker account
cases.method: Exercise the workflow

cases.title: User requests credential removal
cases.method: Exercise the workflow
cases.expected: Verified secure clear + audit; never read back

cases.title: Backend unavailable
cases.method: Inject backend unavailability during a validation/onboarding attempt
cases.expected: Fail-closed; customer-safe UNAVAILABLE; no partial state

cases.title: Agent unavailable
cases.method: Make the Windows agent unreachable
cases.expected: Validation UNAVAILABLE (retryable); customer not asked to re-enter correct creds

cases.title: Validation unavailable (dirty baseline / isolation fault)
cases.method: Force validation_baseline_dirty / isolation_check_failed
cases.expected: UNAVAILABLE; platform fault; probe never runs against an unproven path

cases.title: Worker unavailable
cases.method: Stop the ingest worker with jobs pending
cases.expected: No dispatch; jobs remain PENDING; no order; final-dispatch gate intact on resume
cases.pass_criteria: No order while worker down; clean resume

cases.title: Timeout (validation transport)
cases.method: Force a read timeout within the timeout contract
cases.expected: AMBIGUOUS timeout reconciled, never treated as failure; contract 175>165>120+30 holds

cases.title: Bridge unavailable
cases.method: Make the host bridge unreachable
cases.expected: No dispatch via the bridge; upstream claim gate still refuses ineligible jobs
cases.pass_criteria: No order; no ineligible job served

cases.title: Credential failure (unsealable / scrub-unverified)
cases.method: Force credential_unsealable / credential_scrub_unverified
cases.expected: UNAVAILABLE; HEALTHY never written before a verified scrub

cases.title: Health failure (read error at dispatch)
cases.method: Force a health read error at dispatch with both flags armed
cases.expected: Fail-closed (SR_HEALTH_STATE_CHANGED); order withheld

cases.title: Projection failure (fail-open)
cases.method: Force a record_event/projection error at a durable moment
cases.expected: Authoritative path unaffected; logged to guvfx.operational_events

cases.title: Database rollback (on_commit discarded)
cases.method: Roll back the authoritative transaction that would emit a projection
cases.expected: on_commit projection discarded -> no phantom event
cases.pass_criteria: No phantom event; authoritative rollback clean

cases.title: Network interruption (management channel)
cases.method: Interrupt the management channel mid-operation
cases.expected: Fail-closed / reconciled; no partial provisioning or order

cases.title: Backend restart

cases.title: Agent restart

cases.title: Worker restart

cases.title: Projection restart (re-accrete forward)
cases.method: Disable then re-enable OPERATIONS_EVENTS_ENABLED
cases.expected: Recording resumes forward; no backfill of the gap; authoritative unaffected

cases.title: Scheduler restart
cases.method: Restart h1/m5/h4 schedulers
cases.expected: Due-selection resumes; refusal parity intact; bar_close dedup holds
cases.pass_criteria: No duplicate refusal event; parity intact

cases.title: Validation retry (after a transient UNAVAILABLE)
cases.method: Retry a UNAVAILABLE validation once the platform recovers
cases.expected: Retryable UNAVAILABLE converges to HEALTHY/NEEDS_ATTENTION on retry

cases.title: Health convergence after recovery
cases.method: Recover a degraded account to HEALTHY
cases.expected: success_threshold consecutive successes -> HEALTHY; resume_eligible set

cases.title: Execution restart (resume execution after disarm/rearm)
cases.method: Disarm then re-arm the execution gate in the disposable env
cases.expected: Transparent when OFF; enforcing when ON; no order during the transition on ineligible accounts
cases.pass_criteria: No ineligible order across the transition

cases.method: Rehearse redeploying the prior backend image tag

cases.expected: Directory/config swap; probe side-effect-free; no estate/DB impact

cases.title: Database restore rehearsal (disposable env only)

cases.expected: Backup taken, restore verified in a disposable DB
cases.pass_criteria: Restore succeeds in the disposable env; production untouched

cases.expected: Bounded by support workflows

cases.method: Measure time from validation evidence to health net transition
cases.expected: Convergence on customer evidence (scheduler inert)

cases.title: Release recommendation decision matrix
cases.method: Aggregate all area evidence into the release gate; produce GO / GO_WITH_CONDITIONS / NO_GO
cases.expected: A recommendation ONLY after every gate item has evidence; null until certification completes
cases.pass_criteria: Every gate item PASS + no open HIGH/MEDIUM + Sponsor approval for GO
